rca of the issue:
Root cause of mobile subtitle issue: subtitle string is split by
in JSX with no literal space before second text segment; CSS hides
under max-width 767px (.git11-subtitle br { display:none; }), producing concatenated text 'initiative,let’s'. Mitigation: insert explicit whitespace in JSX around line break or replace with responsive text wrappers that preserve spacing.
